firstTransaction.distinction: External readback confirms physical visibility/home/frame and focus, not the internal transaction seal. Here it precedes the second HIDE full post-witness pair; first transaction completion is recorded later.

journalEvidence.limit: Only the final ledger is preserved; intermediate WAL writes have no independent timestamps. Primitive scope end follows existing double-confirmation/sealed after-image code; group-choice completed=true follows activation return. Do not use the empty cleanup ledger alone to claim earlier commit.

firstUnfulfilledInput.observed: The second actual AX press reaches the still-displayed current-card/choose-group handlers with appearance/lifetime absent and stillGrouped=false. No second navigation submission or product SHOW follows. The first transaction subsequently completes. The hidden windows correctly lack ordinary appearance lifetimes; their original retained AX ownership is independently confirmed by the complete witnesses and cleanup.
firstUnfulfilledInput.limits: The second press occurs during final verification, before the first transaction completes. The later complete/fresh revision50 correctly lacks ordinary/group lifetimes for the hidden windows, but does not establish that the old current UI remains clickable after completion. There is no third, post-completion click in this run. No navigation-busy rejection or second engine post-write failure is recorded.

gate.observedDirectoryCoverage: Each witness scope contains exactly two matching owner after-action directory reads; each hide scope contains exactly six, matching its preflight and two full post witnesses. No extra directory producer is observed in these drained intervals.
gate.priorityLimit: Post-transaction held-refresh witness reads run at priority17 while owning their own scope. Priority17 alone is not evidence of an ordinary background read bypassing the gate.
gate.durationDefinition: Use same-ID reserved/drained/ended event uptime differences. Logged durationMS starts before prior-scope queueing and is not the held duration.

latency.nesting: Witness phases, permissions, native reads and worker phases are nested. Hide scope held time includes health, preflight, primitive, READBACK and full post confirmation. Do not add these envelopes together.

scope: Evidence-only. No source changes, native operation replay, budget change or cross-run observation backfill.

interpretationClarification.reason: Distinguish normal hidden-window appearance expiry from the observed pre-completion current-to-held click handoff; do not infer a persistent post-completion UI failure from revision50.
